verdict.rationale: GitHub publishes official OpenAPI descriptions of its REST API in the github/rest-api-description repository. The docs call them stable and generally available, offered in both OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 versions. The probe's 404s at guessed docs.github.com paths don't contradict this, since the spec lives in the repo rather than at a well-known URL. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent confirmation of downloading the spec, and a discoverable well-known spec URL (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: This repository contains OpenAPI descriptions for GitHub's REST API.
As of the 1.1.4 release, this description is considered stable and generally available. The `descriptions` folder contains the 3.0 version of the description.
